title: Helping Starbucks design stores that are inclusive for all
content: The coffee company worked with McKinsey to create a design framework for more inclusive spaces for persons with disabilities.

content: TPG worked with McKinsey to create Rubicon Carbon, a carbon credit management and investment firm that helps enterprises achieve...

title: How Lufthansa is using data to reduce costs and improve spend and carbon transparency
content: Partnering with SAP, the airline developed a clear view of their data, integrating multiple sources from across their global business network. McKinsey’s Spendscape then provided a full understanding of procurement spend—and insights into Scope 3 emissions.

title: Banking on innovation: How ING uses generative AI to put people first
content: The global bank worked closely with QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey, to build, test, and launch a bespoke customer-facing chatbot that uses the latest gen AI technology to meet customer needs.

title: From farm to tablet: Building a new business to solve an old challenge
content: McKinsey partnered with one of Southeast Asia’s largest B2B and B2C retailers, CP AXTRA Public Company Limited, the operator of Makro, to create a new B2B online platform—and provide crucial supply chain resilience for small businesses amid the pandemic.

title: Rewired in action
content: Real-world examples of Digital and AI transformations and how leading companies succeed

title: Partnering on America’s toughest challenges
content: Through publicly available fact-based research and data, we seek to provide better outcomes for those who live and work in the United States.

title: Made in Africa: Catalyzing stronger, sustainable, and inclusive economies
content: Manufacturing is the bedrock of a growing economy. Foreign direct investment can play a key role in nurturing this sector to accelerate sustainability and inclusion in emerging economies.

title: How a government agency is preparing workers to thrive in the skills-based economy
content: Australia’s Department of Regional New South Wales, a government agency supporting rural communities across the state, has worked with McKinsey to build a future-ready workforce.

title: How a global components manufacturer built an ambitious carbon reduction roadmap
content: Danfoss is working to decarbonize the supply chain for some of the world’s most emission-heavy sectors with the help of McKinsey.

title: Undaunted by global disruption, a logistics company embraces bold transformation
content: ECU Worldwide, one of the largest less-than-container-load shipping companies in the world, chose to innovate during the COVID-19 pandemic, working with McKinsey to become tech enabled and revamp its organizational structure.

title: 988: Three digits and the nationwide effort to help millions in crisis
content: Through the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline and other efforts, McKinsey Health Institute is helping develop a community-based approach to crisis care across the United States.

title: An AI power play: Fueling the next wave of innovation in the energy sector
content: How Vistra Corp. is partnering with McKinsey to improve efficiency and reduce emissions by using AI.

title: How a manufacturing moonshot was made
content: During COVID-19, the global respiratory medical-device pioneer Vyaire faced an extraordinary demand situation. With partnership from Spirit AeroSystems and McKinsey, they reached unprecedented new production heights.

title: Protecting workers through award-winning design
content: 3M and McKinsey Design have partnered to create a welding helmet that has transformed the daily lives of welders around the world. The product has won nearly a dozen international awards, including a 2021 “Best of the Best” Red Dot Award.

title: How Telkomsel transformed to reach digital-first consumers
content: A 26-year-old telecom incumbent seized an opportunity to reinvent itself—and attract its next generation of customers.

title: Flying across the sea, propelled by AI
content: To help Emirates Team New Zealand successfully defend their America’s Cup title, we introduced them to a new sailor: a McKinsey-built AI bot.

title: How a steel plant in India tapped the value of data—and won global acclaim
content: By upskilling employees and innovating with analytics, Tata Steel’s plant in Kalinganagar, India, achieved performance gains that earned it recognition as a leading digital facility by the World Economic Forum.

title: Reimagining the real estate industry for the next normal
content: How one real-estate developer’s focus on digital reinvention before coronavirus is helping it navigate the current crisis and beyond.

title: Inside a mining company’s AI transformation
content: How copper-mining giant Freeport-McMoRan unlocked next-level performance with help from McKinsey data scientists and agile coaches.

title: JobsOhio and the long-term, innovative revitalization of a state’s economy
content: How did Ohio become a destination for business growth? A new program turned the state’s economy around, with some help from McKinsey.

title: McKinsey’s new Sustainability Academy helps clients upskill workers for the net-zero transition
content: The new program, designed by consultants from McKinsey Sustainability and learning experts from McKinsey Academy, helps companies accelerate change through their employees.

title: Tearing the ‘paper ceiling’: McKinsey supports effort driving upward mobility for millions of workers
content: Bachelor’s degree requirements, the default for most middle and high-wage jobs, exclude many skilled workers. A new nationwide campaign is encouraging employers to change hiring practices.
